```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(caret)
library(car)
library(pROC)
```

# Data

```{r load-data}
df <- read_csv("../../01_data/4_model/v2_model_dataset.csv",
               col_types = cols(datetime = col_skip()))

# factor encoding
df$year         <- relevel(factor(df$year), ref = "2025")
df$season       <- factor(df$season)
df$time_of_day  <- factor(df$time_of_day)
df$peak_hour    <- factor(df$peak_hour)
df$heating_dd   <- factor(df$heating_dd)
df$cap_threshold <- factor(df$cap_threshold)

nrow(df)
summary(df %>% select(rtm_price, base_energy, total_adder, RTRSVPOR, RTRSVPOFF, RTRDP))
```

# Train/test split

Use the same 80/20 split for all sub-models so we can compare predictions on a common test set.

```{r split}
set.seed(42)
train_idx <- createDataPartition(df$rtm_price, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train <- df[train_idx, ]
test  <- df[-train_idx, ]

cat("Train:", nrow(train), "  Test:", nrow(test), "\n")
```

---

# Part A: Base energy model

```{r partA-filter}
# filter out very low base_energy for log transform (same logic as v1's rtm_price > 2.3)
train_A <- train[train$base_energy > 2.3, ]
test_A  <- test[test$base_energy > 2.3, ]
cat("Part A — Train:", nrow(train_A), "  Test:", nrow(test_A),
    "  (dropped", nrow(train) - nrow(train_A), "/", nrow(test) - nrow(test_A), "low-price rows)\n")
```

```{r partA-model}
mod_A <- lm(log10(base_energy) ~ spare_capacity + ng_price_monthly +
              season + cap_threshold + time_of_day + heating_dd +
              degree_days + year + peak_hour,
            data = train_A)
summary(mod_A)
```

```{r partA-cv}
ctrl <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = 5, savePredictions = "final")

set.seed(42)
cv_A <- train(
  log10(base_energy) ~ spare_capacity + ng_price_monthly +
    season + cap_threshold + time_of_day + heating_dd +
    degree_days + year + peak_hour,
  data = train_A, method = "lm", trControl = ctrl
)
cat("CV results:\n")
print(cv_A$results)

pred_A_test <- predict(cv_A, newdata = test_A)
cat("\nTest set (log10 scale):\n")
print(postResample(pred_A_test, log10(test_A$base_energy)))
```

```{r partA-diagnostics, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(mod_A, which = c(1, 2))
```

# Parts B & C: Per-component adder models

Helper function for the two-part hurdle: logistic gate + log-OLS magnitude.

```{r hurdle-helpers}
fit_hurdle <- function(train_df, test_df, component, covariates) {
  active_col <- paste0(tolower(component), "_active")

  # --- Part B: logistic gate ---
  gate_formula <- as.formula(paste(active_col, "~", covariates))
  gate_model <- glm(gate_formula, data = train_df, family = binomial)

  gate_pred_train <- predict(gate_model, newdata = train_df, type = "response")
  gate_pred_test  <- predict(gate_model, newdata = test_df,  type = "response")

  # ROC/AUC
  roc_obj <- roc(train_df[[active_col]], gate_pred_train, quiet = TRUE)

  # --- Part C: magnitude (active subset only) ---
  train_active <- train_df[train_df[[active_col]] == 1, ]
  test_active  <- test_df[test_df[[active_col]] == 1, ]

  mag_formula <- as.formula(paste("log10(", component, ") ~", covariates))
  mag_model <- lm(mag_formula, data = train_active)

  # Duan's smearing estimator
  resids <- residuals(mag_model)
  smearing_factor <- mean(10^resids)

  # safe predict: handle factor levels unseen in the active subset
  safe_predict_mag <- function(model, newdata) {
    nd <- newdata
    for (v in names(model$xlevels)) {
      nd[[v]] <- factor(nd[[v]], levels = model$xlevels[[v]])
    }
    pred <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(nd))
    valid <- complete.cases(nd[, names(model$xlevels), drop = FALSE])
    if (sum(valid) > 0) {
      pred[valid] <- predict(model, newdata = nd[valid, ])
    }
    # for rows with unseen levels, use the training-set mean as fallback
    pred[!valid] <- mean(model$fitted.values)
    pred
  }

  mag_pred_log_train <- safe_predict_mag(mag_model, train_df)
  mag_pred_log_test  <- safe_predict_mag(mag_model, test_df)
  mag_pred_train <- 10^mag_pred_log_train * smearing_factor
  mag_pred_test  <- 10^mag_pred_log_test  * smearing_factor

  # --- combined: P(active) * E[magnitude | active] ---
  combined_train <- gate_pred_train * mag_pred_train
  combined_test  <- gate_pred_test  * mag_pred_test

  list(
    component     = component,
    gate_model    = gate_model,
    mag_model     = mag_model,
    roc           = roc_obj,
    smearing      = smearing_factor,
    gate_pred_train = gate_pred_train,
    gate_pred_test  = gate_pred_test,
    combined_train  = combined_train,
    combined_test   = combined_test,
    n_active_train  = nrow(train_active),
    n_active_test   = nrow(test_active)
  )
}
```

```{r fit-hurdles}
covar_str <- "spare_capacity + season + time_of_day + degree_days + peak_hour + year"

hurdle_OR  <- fit_hurdle(train, test, "RTRSVPOR",  covar_str)
hurdle_OFF <- fit_hurdle(train, test, "RTRSVPOFF", covar_str)
hurdle_RD  <- fit_hurdle(train, test, "RTRDP",     covar_str)

cat("=== Hurdle summaries ===\n")
for (h in list(hurdle_OR, hurdle_OFF, hurdle_RD)) {
  cat(sprintf("\n%s: AUC=%.3f, smearing=%.3f, active train=%d, active test=%d\n",
              h$component, auc(h$roc), h$smearing, h$n_active_train, h$n_active_test))
}
```

## Gate diagnostics (Part B)

```{r gate-diagnostics, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
par(mfrow = c(1, 3))
for (h in list(hurdle_OR, hurdle_OFF, hurdle_RD)) {
  plot(h$roc, main = paste(h$component, "— AUC:", round(auc(h$roc), 3)))
}
```

### Calibration: predicted probability vs observed activation by decile

```{r gate-calibration, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
calibration_plot <- function(h, data) {
  active_col <- paste0(tolower(h$component), "_active")
  cal_df <- data.frame(
    pred_prob = predict(h$gate_model, newdata = data, type = "response"),
    actual    = data[[active_col]]
  )
  cal_df$decile <- ntile(cal_df$pred_prob, 10)
  cal_df %>%
    group_by(decile) %>%
    summarise(mean_pred = mean(pred_prob), mean_obs = mean(actual), .groups = "drop")
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 3))
for (h in list(hurdle_OR, hurdle_OFF, hurdle_RD)) {
  cal <- calibration_plot(h, train)
  plot(cal$mean_pred, cal$mean_obs,
       xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1),
       xlab = "Predicted P(active)", ylab = "Observed rate",
       main = paste(h$component, "calibration"))
  abline(0, 1, lty = 2, col = "gray40")
}
```

# Recombination in price space

$$
\hat{P}_{\text{RTM}} = \hat{P}_{\text{base}} + \sum_{c} P(c > 0 \mid X) \cdot E[c \mid c > 0, X]
$$

```{r recombine}
# Base energy predictions (back to levels)
base_pred_train <- 10^predict(mod_A, newdata = train)
base_pred_test  <- 10^predict(mod_A, newdata = test)

# For rows where base_energy <= 2.3 (filtered out of Part A), use raw base_energy
# as a floor — the model can't predict these anyway
base_pred_train[train$base_energy <= 2.3] <- train$base_energy[train$base_energy <= 2.3]
base_pred_test[test$base_energy <= 2.3]   <- test$base_energy[test$base_energy <= 2.3]

# Total predicted price
v2_pred_train <- base_pred_train +
  hurdle_OR$combined_train + hurdle_OFF$combined_train + hurdle_RD$combined_train
v2_pred_test <- base_pred_test +
  hurdle_OR$combined_test + hurdle_OFF$combined_test + hurdle_RD$combined_test

cat("=== V2 test set performance (price space, $/MWh) ===\n")
cat(sprintf("RMSE: %.2f\n", sqrt(mean((v2_pred_test - test$rtm_price)^2))))
cat(sprintf("MAE:  %.2f\n", mean(abs(v2_pred_test - test$rtm_price))))
cat(sprintf("R²:   %.4f\n", cor(v2_pred_test, test$rtm_price)^2))
```

## V1 baseline comparison

Refit v1 (single log-price model) on the same train/test split.

```{r v1-baseline}
train_v1 <- train[train$rtm_price > 2.3, ]
test_v1  <- test[test$rtm_price > 2.3, ]

mod_v1 <- lm(log10(rtm_price) ~ spare_capacity + ng_price_monthly +
               season + cap_threshold + time_of_day + heating_dd +
               degree_days + year + peak_hour,
             data = train_v1)

v1_pred_test <- 10^predict(mod_v1, newdata = test)
v1_pred_test[test$rtm_price <= 2.3] <- test$rtm_price[test$rtm_price <= 2.3]

cat("=== V1 test set performance (price space, $/MWh) ===\n")
cat(sprintf("RMSE: %.2f\n", sqrt(mean((v1_pred_test - test$rtm_price)^2))))
cat(sprintf("MAE:  %.2f\n", mean(abs(v1_pred_test - test$rtm_price))))
cat(sprintf("R²:   %.4f\n", cor(v1_pred_test, test$rtm_price)^2))
```

## Stratified performance

```{r stratified}
eval_subset <- function(pred, actual, label) {
  data.frame(
    subset = label,
    n      = length(pred),
    RMSE   = sqrt(mean((pred - actual)^2)),
    MAE    = mean(abs(pred - actual)),
    R2     = cor(pred, actual)^2
  )
}

adder_active_test <- test$total_adder > 0

results <- bind_rows(
  eval_subset(v2_pred_test[!adder_active_test], test$rtm_price[!adder_active_test], "V2 — adder=0"),
  eval_subset(v2_pred_test[adder_active_test],  test$rtm_price[adder_active_test],  "V2 — adder>0"),
  eval_subset(v1_pred_test[!adder_active_test], test$rtm_price[!adder_active_test], "V1 — adder=0"),
  eval_subset(v1_pred_test[adder_active_test],  test$rtm_price[adder_active_test],  "V1 — adder>0")
)

# Tail performance (top 5% and top 1% of actual prices)
p95 <- quantile(test$rtm_price, 0.95)
p99 <- quantile(test$rtm_price, 0.99)

results <- bind_rows(results,
  eval_subset(v2_pred_test[test$rtm_price >= p95], test$rtm_price[test$rtm_price >= p95], "V2 — top 5%"),
  eval_subset(v1_pred_test[test$rtm_price >= p95], test$rtm_price[test$rtm_price >= p95], "V1 — top 5%"),
  eval_subset(v2_pred_test[test$rtm_price >= p99], test$rtm_price[test$rtm_price >= p99], "V2 — top 1%"),
  eval_subset(v1_pred_test[test$rtm_price >= p99], test$rtm_price[test$rtm_price >= p99], "V1 — top 1%")
)

print(results)
```

## Predicted vs actual

```{r pred-vs-actual, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
plot_df <- data.frame(
  actual = test$rtm_price,
  v1 = v1_pred_test,
  v2 = v2_pred_test,
  adder_active = adder_active_test
)

p1 <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = actual, y = v1, color = adder_active)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.4, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  coord_fixed(xlim = c(-50, 500), ylim = c(-50, 500)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#1f77b4", "TRUE" = "#d62728")) +
  labs(title = "V1: single log-price model", x = "Actual $/MWh", y = "Predicted $/MWh")

p2 <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = actual, y = v2, color = adder_active)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.4, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  coord_fixed(xlim = c(-50, 500), ylim = c(-50, 500)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#1f77b4", "TRUE" = "#d62728")) +
  labs(title = "V2: decomposed model", x = "Actual $/MWh", y = "Predicted $/MWh")

gridExtra::grid.arrange(p1, p2, ncol = 2)
```
